legal.privacy.metadataDescription.source: What Keryx and its browser extension do — and don't do — with your questions, wallet address, and page data.
legal.privacy.metadataDescription.text: Keryx 及其浏览器扩展如何处理您的问题、钱包地址和页面数据，以及不会进行哪些处理。

legal.privacy.updated.source: Last updated {date} · covers keryx.cc and the Keryx browser extension
legal.privacy.updated.text: 最近更新 {date} · 适用于 keryx.cc 和 Keryx 浏览器扩展

legal.privacy.shortVersion.summary.source: Keryx is a reading agent that answers questions and pays the writers it cites, in USDC on {network}. {publishedNotice} The separately labeled private research pilot restricts result access to the paying account, while Keryx and the disclosed AI provider still process the question. Choose the appropriate mode before submitting. We do not sell question or wallet data to data brokers. Hosting and wallet services process operational data as described below.
legal.privacy.shortVersion.summary.text: Keryx 是回答问题并在 {network} 上以 USDC 向所引用作者付款的阅读代理。{publishedNotice} 单独标注的私密研究试点将结果访问限于付款账户，但 Keryx 和披露的 AI 服务商仍会处理问题。提交前请选择适当模式。我们不向数据经纪商出售问题或钱包数据。托管及钱包服务按下述方式处理运营数据。

legal.privacy.publicQuestions.heading.source: When you ask a public question

legal.privacy.publicQuestions.processing.source: Your question is sent to our server, which sends it to a configured large-language-model provider to plan the research and write the grounded answer. The question, the answer, the agent's reasoning trace, and the payments it triggered are stored and published at a permalink ({dispatchPath}), and canonical questions appear in the public {archiveLink}. Don't put anything in a question you wouldn't put on a public page.
legal.privacy.publicQuestions.processing.text: 问题发送至我们的服务器，再交给已配置的大语言模型服务商规划研究并撰写有依据的答案。问题、答案、代理推理轨迹及触发的付款被存储并发布在永久链接（{dispatchPath}），标准问题出现在公开{archiveLink}。请勿在问题中包含不愿公开到网页的内容。

legal.privacy.publicQuestions.rateLimits.source: The free, no-wallet tier is rate-limited by a one-way bucket derived from the IP address. The raw IP is not written to the database or joined to your questions; expired limiter buckets are deleted automatically.
legal.privacy.publicQuestions.rateLimits.text: 免费免钱包层通过从 IP 地址单向派生的桶限流。原始 IP 不写入数据库，也不与问题关联；过期限流桶自动删除。

legal.privacy.literatureWorkspace.localD.source: The {literatureLink} stores saved paper metadata, your review question and screening notes on this browser. It requires no account and has no cloud sync. Keryx does not upload these records when you save, screen, export or restore them. Anyone controlling this browser profile or scripts running on this site can access its local data.
legal.privacy.literatureWorkspace.localD.text: {literatureLink}在此浏览器存储已保存论文元数据、综述问题和筛选笔记。无需账户，无云同步。保存、筛选、导出或恢复时，Keryx 不上传这些记录。控制此浏览器配置文件的人或在此网站运行的脚本可访问本地数据。

legal.privacy.literatureWorkspace.compar.source: Preparing a comparison puts the saved review question and two paper links in an editable question URL; browser history can retain that URL. Notes and screening decisions are omitted. Submitting the question uses the ordinary research policy described above. Downloaded CSV/JSON files contain your personal notes; keep them in appropriate storage. Clearing the workspace removes its browser record but does not delete exports, browser history or disk remnants.
legal.privacy.literatureWorkspace.compar.text: 准备比较会将已保存的综述问题和两篇论文链接放入可编辑的问题 URL；浏览器历史可能保留该 URL。笔记和筛选决定不包含在内。提交问题采用上述普通研究政策。下载的 CSV/JSON 文件包含个人笔记，请妥善存储。清空工作区删除浏览器记录，但不删除导出、浏览器历史或磁盘残留。

legal.privacy.privatePilot.processing.source: Private purchasing requires an authenticated paying wallet and an enabled deployment. The private checkout shows the AI provider, model and endpoint before you buy. Keryx and that provider process your question; this is not end-to-end encryption. The private result and history routes require sign-in as the paying account. Private jobs use separate storage and are excluded from the public research archive and public payment activity. Payment records on the underlying network may still be public.
legal.privacy.privatePilot.processing.text: 私密购买需要经认证的付款钱包和已启用部署。私密结账在购买前显示 AI 服务商、模型及端点。Keryx 和该服务商会处理问题；这不是端到端加密。私密结果和历史路由要求以付款账户登录。私密任务使用独立存储，不纳入公开研究档案和公开付款活动。底层网络付款记录仍可能公开。

legal.privacy.privatePilot.localRecovery.source: The browser asks you to accept saving the private question and payment signature locally before purchase. Recovery files also contain the question and signature in plaintext. Keep exports in private storage. Importing a file saves a local recovery copy; it does not send a new payment. Anyone controlling your browser profile or scripts running on this site could access local data.
legal.privacy.privatePilot.localRecovery.text: 购买前，浏览器请求您同意在本地保存私密问题和付款签名。恢复文件也以明文包含问题及签名。请将导出保存在私密存储。导入文件会保存本地恢复副本，不会发送新付款。控制浏览器配置文件的人或在本站运行的脚本可访问本地数据。

legal.privacy.privatePilot.localDeletion.source: In {researchLink}, choose Delete local private data and confirm to remove a saved question and signature from the browser journal. A minimal account/job marker remains to prevent another submission. An exported file can restore recovery access later. Deletion does not cancel a signed or in-flight payment, refund funds, delete the server result, or remove exports, backups, disk remnants or copies in other open tabs. Close other tabs to clear their displayed copies. This is not secure disk erasure.
legal.privacy.privatePilot.localDeletion.text: 在{researchLink}中选择“删除本地私密数据”并确认，从浏览器日志删除已保存问题和签名。保留最小账户/任务标记以防再次提交。导出文件可在以后恢复访问。删除不会取消已签名或进行中的付款、退款、删除服务器结果，或移除导出、备份、磁盘残留及其他打开标签页的副本。关闭其他标签页可清除其显示副本。这不是安全磁盘擦除。

legal.privacy.aggregateCounters.collecti.source: Keryx keeps first-party daily counters so we can see where the product is slow or confusing: for example, how many landing views became accepted asks and completed answers, or how many creator registrations reached verification, a settled citation, and a cash-out. Each row contains only a UTC date, an allowlisted event name, and a count. It contains no wallet, IP, cookie, fingerprint, user agent, referrer, question, source, or payment identifier. Landing counting uses tab-local session storage only to avoid counting the same tab repeatedly that day; it creates no stable user id and sends requests without credentials. These are event totals, never claimed as unique people.
legal.privacy.aggregateCounters.collecti.text: Keryx 保留第一方每日计数，以了解产品的缓慢或易混淆环节，例如多少首页浏览变成获接受的提问和已完成答案，或多少创作者注册达到核验、已结算引用和提现。每行仅包含 UTC 日期、允许列表中的事件名及计数，不含钱包、IP、cookie、指纹、用户代理、引荐来源、问题、来源或付款标识。首页计数仅用标签页本地会话存储避免同日重复计数，不创建稳定用户 ID，请求不携带凭据。这些是事件总数，不宣称为独立人数。

legal.privacy.walletAccounts.accountData.source: External wallets use Sign-In-With-Ethereum. Keryx stores your wallet address, your role (asker/creator), and a last-seen timestamp. Keryx does not store your email address, Google password, or phone number in its account records. Everything you do on-chain — registrations, payments, withdrawals — is public on Arc by the nature of a blockchain, and Keryx links to it rather than hiding it. Session keys for browser co-signing are generated in your browser and never sent to us.
legal.privacy.walletAccounts.accountData.text: 外部钱包使用 Sign-In-With-Ethereum。Keryx 存储钱包地址、角色（提问者/创作者）及最后访问时间戳。账户记录不存储邮箱、Google 密码或电话号码。区块链特性使 Arc 上的注册、付款及提现全部公开；Keryx 提供链接而非隐藏。浏览器共同签名会话密钥在浏览器生成，从不发送给我们。

legal.privacy.walletAccounts.mainnetReco.source: Mainnet sessions retain an encrypted signing key on this browser. Logout locks it but does not erase funded recovery or refund a Gateway balance. Clearing browser storage or losing this device can lose access; repeating a wallet signature is not a guaranteed backup. This assumes a trusted application origin and browser: compromised same-origin script can use the stored wrapping key to decrypt custody despite its nonexportability, putting deposited funds at risk.
legal.privacy.walletAccounts.mainnetReco.text: 主网会话在此浏览器保留加密签名密钥。退出会锁定它，但不擦除已注资恢复数据，也不退还 Gateway 余额。清除浏览器存储或丢失设备可能导致失去访问；再次钱包签名不是保证有效的备份。此机制假设应用来源及浏览器可信：受损的同源脚本可能使用所存封装密钥解密托管数据，即便密钥不可导出，也会危及存入资金。

legal.privacy.googleSignIn.heading.text: 可选 Google 钱包登录

legal.privacy.googleSignIn.processing.source: When Google sign-in is enabled, Google authenticates your account and Circle User-Controlled Wallets handles the linked wallet. Google and Circle process the identity information you consent to share, such as your email and basic profile, under their own privacy policies. Keryx uses the authenticated Circle wallet to sign you in; it does not request access to your Gmail messages, Drive files, or Google password. Google sign-in alone does not authorize spending.
legal.privacy.googleSignIn.processing.text: 启用 Google 登录时，Google 认证账户，Circle User-Controlled Wallets 处理关联钱包。Google 和 Circle 按各自隐私政策处理您同意共享的邮箱、基本资料等身份信息。Keryx 使用已认证 Circle 钱包登录，不请求 Gmail 邮件、Drive 文件或 Google 密码访问。仅 Google 登录不授权支出。

legal.privacy.googleSignIn.credentials.source: The browser sends the Circle user-session token to Keryx to verify wallet ownership and request wallet actions. Keryx forwards it to Circle for those operations and does not persist it in account records. After sign-in, the browser keeps the user token and signing encryption key in memory. During the redirect, short-lived device credentials and login state are saved in this tab's session storage. The Circle SDK also saves OAuth state, nonce and provider entries in local storage. The Keryx continuation is valid for five minutes; returning to complete the flow removes its continuation and matching SDK entries. Abandoning the redirect can leave expired login data in browser storage. The Google callback token is removed from the page URL after the return flow. A public wallet identity is remembered locally and checked against a current Keryx session before reconnecting.
legal.privacy.googleSignIn.credentials.text: 浏览器将 Circle 用户会话令牌发送给 Keryx，以核验钱包所有权并请求钱包操作。Keryx 为这些操作转发给 Circle，不将其持久化到账户记录。登录后，浏览器在内存保留用户令牌和签名加密密钥。重定向期间，短期设备凭据及登录状态保存在此标签页会话存储；Circle SDK 也在本地存储保存 OAuth 状态、nonce 和服务商条目。Keryx 续接有效五分钟；返回完成流程会移除续接及匹配 SDK 条目。放弃重定向可能在浏览器存储留下过期登录数据。返回流程后从页面 URL 移除 Google 回调令牌。公开钱包身份在本地记住，重新连接前与当前 Keryx 会话核对。

legal.privacy.googleSignIn.recovery.source: Reloading requires reconnecting Google for new owner-wallet signatures. Google account recovery does not automatically restore the separate encrypted research signing key retained on this browser. Signing out clears Google wallet signing credentials but retains funded research-key recovery as described above.
legal.privacy.googleSignIn.recovery.text: 重新加载后，需要重新连接 Google 才能获得新的所有者钱包签名。Google 账户恢复不会自动恢复此浏览器保留的独立加密研究签名密钥。退出会清除 Google 钱包签名凭据，但按上述方式保留已注资研究密钥恢复数据。

legal.privacy.sourceListings.publicAndPr.source: A source's name, URL, description, prices, and payout wallet are public — that is the product. Two things stay private: the webhook URL + signing secret you may register for citation notifications, and your content itself, which is stored encrypted on IPFS and only decrypted after a payment. API keys are shown to you once and stored only as a salted hash; we cannot recover them.
legal.privacy.sourceListings.publicAndPr.text: 来源名称、URL、说明、价格和收款钱包公开，这是产品的一部分。两项信息保持私密：您可为引用通知注册的 webhook URL 及签名密钥，以及内容本身，后者在 IPFS 加密存储，仅付款后解密。API 密钥仅向您显示一次，只保存加盐哈希；我们无法恢复。

legal.privacy.extension.destinations.source: The extension sends API requests only to {serviceOrigin}. Opening the popup checks research availability before you ask; the service and its hosting provider receive ordinary request metadata such as your IP address. Opening a link navigates to the destination you choose. Specifically:
legal.privacy.extension.destinations.text: 扩展仅向 {serviceOrigin} 发送 API 请求。打开弹窗会在提问前检查研究可用性；服务及托管商收到 IP 地址等普通请求元数据。打开链接会导航至您选择的目标。具体而言：

legal.privacy.extension.asking.source: When you press Ask, it sends your edited question or selected text, source budget, research depth and scholarly-search choice to the Keryx API. If you check Include this page URL as a source, the displayed page URL is appended to the question. Questions, answers, reasoning traces and associated payment records from this public research flow are published and retained. The configured AI provider processes the question; discovery services can receive search queries. Do not submit confidential or personal information you do not want published.
legal.privacy.extension.asking.text: 按下“提问”后，扩展将编辑后的问题或所选文本、来源预算、研究深度及学术搜索选项发送到 Keryx API。勾选“将此页面 URL 作为来源”时，将显示的页面 URL 附加到问题。此公开研究流程的问题、答案、推理轨迹及相关付款记录会发布并保留。已配置 AI 服务商处理问题；发现服务可能收到搜索查询。请勿提交不愿公开的机密或个人信息。

legal.privacy.extension.listAction.source: “List this page as a paid source”

legal.privacy.extension.listPage.source: When you pick {listAction}, it opens the Keryx register page with the page URL and title pre-filled. Open editable question on web puts the edited question and chosen options in a web URL; it can be retained in browser history and processed by the website. Submitting on web uses the research policy above.
legal.privacy.extension.listPage.text: 选择{listAction}时，会打开预填页面 URL 和标题的 Keryx 注册页。“在网页打开可编辑问题”将编辑后的问题及选项放入网页 URL，可能被浏览器历史保留并由网站处理。在网页提交采用上述研究政策。

legal.privacy.extension.selection.source: It reads the current tab URL, title and text selection only on your invocation, to prepare editable controls or the requested creator link. It runs a selection-reading script for this purpose, without collecting full-page text or browsing history in the background.
legal.privacy.extension.selection.text: 扩展仅在您调用时读取当前标签页 URL、标题及所选文本，以准备可编辑控件或请求的创作者链接。为此运行选区读取脚本，不在后台收集全文或浏览历史。

legal.privacy.extension.localStorage.source: {storageApi} holds the right-click hand-off, including selected text and page context until the popup consumes it, and at most ten completed public report URLs with timestamps. The recent list stores no questions or answers. Clear device list removes only that list; it does not delete hosted reports, browser history or downloaded exports. The extension has no analytics beacon or advertising telemetry. An eligible anonymous result can return a private, short-lived, single-use account-claim ticket held only in popup memory, excluded from storage, report links and exports. Save this research to your account deliberately opens the hosted claim page with the ticket in a URL fragment; the website processes it with sign-in and ownership checks, and browser history can retain the link. Closing the popup loses the ticket. Claiming a run does not make published research private.
legal.privacy.extension.localStorage.text: {storageApi}保存右键交接数据，包括所选文本和页面上下文，直到弹窗读取；另保存最多十个已完成公开报告 URL 及时间戳。近期列表不保存问题或答案。“清除设备列表”仅删除该列表，不删除托管报告、浏览历史或下载导出。扩展没有分析信标或广告遥测。合格匿名结果可返回私密、短期、一次性账户认领票据，仅存于弹窗内存，不纳入存储、报告链接和导出。“将此研究保存到账户”主动以 URL 片段中的票据打开托管认领页；网站通过登录及所有权检查处理，浏览器历史可能保留链接。关闭弹窗会丢失票据。认领运行不会让已发布研究变为私密。

legal.privacy.thirdParties.workersPolicy.text: Workers AI 数据使用政策

legal.privacy.thirdParties.reasoningAndP.source: The configured reasoning provider processes question text to produce answers under its API terms. When enabled, the experimental Cloudflare Workers AI fallback can process public research questions and source excerpts after other providers fail, or when you select its model. Cloudflare states that Workers AI customer content is not used to train models without consent; see its {workersPolicyLink}. Private research continues to use only the provider disclosed at checkout. Circle and the Arc network process the on-chain payments. Pinata pins the encrypted IPFS content creators upload. Their processing is governed by their respective service terms.
legal.privacy.thirdParties.reasoningAndP.text: 已配置推理服务商按其 API 条款处理问题文本并生成答案。启用后，实验性 Cloudflare Workers AI 回退可在其他服务商失败或您选其模型时处理公开研究问题和来源摘录。Cloudflare 表示未经同意不会用 Workers AI 客户内容训练模型，参见其{workersPolicyLink}。私密研究仍仅用结账披露的服务商。Circle 和 Arc 网络处理链上付款。Pinata 固定保存创作者上传的加密 IPFS 内容。处理受各自服务条款约束。

legal.privacy.thirdParties.webServices.source: The website is served through Cloudflare. Its performance beacon can send page-load metrics to Cloudflare; see its {collectionLink}. Wallet connection tools, including MetaMask and WalletConnect when available, also communicate with their service providers. WalletConnect operational telemetry has been observed on the website. These web services are separate from the extension and from Keryx's aggregate product counters.
legal.privacy.thirdParties.webServices.text: 网站由 Cloudflare 提供服务。其性能信标可向 Cloudflare 发送页面加载指标，参见{collectionLink}。MetaMask 及可用时的 WalletConnect 等钱包连接工具也与其服务商通信。网站已观察到 WalletConnect 运营遥测。这些网页服务独立于扩展和 Keryx 汇总产品计数器。

legal.privacy.retentionAndContact.record.source: Published dispatches and on-chain records are retained indefinitely — they are the public ledger the product is built on. Expired rate-limit buckets are deleted; aggregate product counters retain only daily totals. Private pilot records are retained for operation and recovery; no automatic server deletion schedule currently applies. Local deletion does not remove server records or operational backups. If this policy changes, the date above changes with it. Questions, corrections, or deletion requests for off-chain data: {contactAddress}. On-chain data cannot be deleted by anyone, including us.
legal.privacy.retentionAndContact.record.text: 已发布研究和链上记录无限期保留，是产品依托的公开账本。过期限流桶删除；汇总产品计数器仅保留每日总数。私密试点记录为运营及恢复保留，目前无自动服务器删除安排。本地删除不移除服务器记录或运营备份。政策变化时更新上方日期。链下数据问题、更正或删除请求：{contactAddress}。包括我们在内，任何人均无法删除链上数据。

legal.terms.metadataDescription.source: Terms for using Keryx research, linked wallets, paid sources and creator payments.
legal.terms.metadataDescription.text: 使用 Keryx 研究、关联钱包、付费来源及创作者付款的条款。

legal.terms.effective.text: 2026 年 10 月 5 日生效 · Keryx 服务

legal.terms.usingKeryx.scope.source: These terms apply when you use Keryx's hosted research service, connect a wallet, buy source access, or list content for sale. The browser extension, desktop and agent integrations can connect to the same hosted service. Use Keryx only when you are permitted to use it under the laws that apply to you.
legal.terms.usingKeryx.scope.text: 使用 Keryx 托管研究服务、连接钱包、购买来源访问或上架内容销售时适用这些条款。浏览器扩展、桌面及代理集成可连接同一托管服务。仅在适用法律允许时使用 Keryx。

legal.terms.usingKeryx.researchLimitatio.source: Keryx produces automated research with citations and visible payment records. Answers can be incomplete or mistaken. Check the cited material and use your own judgment before acting on an answer, especially for medical, legal or financial decisions. Keryx does not guarantee a particular research result or creator income.
legal.terms.usingKeryx.researchLimitatio.text: Keryx 生成带引用及可见付款记录的自动研究。答案可能不完整或有误。依据答案行动前，请检查所引材料并自行判断，尤其是医疗、法律或金融决策。Keryx 不保证特定研究结果或创作者收入。

legal.terms.accountsAndRecovery.authoriz.source: You are responsible for the accounts, devices and wallet authorizations you use. Where available, Google sign-in connects to a Circle user-controlled wallet; signing in does not itself approve spending. Review wallet actions and the allowance, duration and question limit before enabling a research budget.
legal.terms.accountsAndRecovery.authoriz.text: 您须对所用账户、设备及钱包授权负责。可用时 Google 登录连接 Circle 用户控制钱包；登录本身不批准支出。启用研究预算前，请审阅钱包操作、额度、时长及问题上限。

legal.terms.accountsAndRecovery.localRec.source: A funded browser research key is separate from the linked owner wallet. Signing out locks that key but preserves its local recovery data. Clearing browser data or losing the device can lose access to it. Google account recovery does not automatically restore this research key. Keep any recovery exports private and follow the recovery instructions shown in the product.
legal.terms.accountsAndRecovery.localRec.text: 已注资浏览器研究密钥独立于关联的所有者钱包。退出会锁定密钥但保留本地恢复数据。清除浏览器数据或丢失设备可能失去访问。Google 账户恢复不会自动恢复此研究密钥。请私密保存恢复导出，并遵循产品显示的恢复说明。

legal.terms.pricesAndDelivery.charges.source: Review the displayed price or spending limit before authorizing a paid action. Source access tolls, citation rewards, service fees and network fees can be separate charges. A spending allowance permits spending within its limits; it does not guarantee that all of the allowance will be used or that every selected source will be delivered.
legal.terms.pricesAndDelivery.charges.text: 授权付费操作前请审阅显示的价格或支出上限。来源访问费、引用奖励、服务费和网络费可能分别收取。支出额度允许在其限制内支出，不保证全部使用，也不保证交付每个所选来源。

legal.terms.pricesAndDelivery.uncertainP.source: Payment records distinguish settled, pending, failed and simulated actions. A pending action is not proof of payment completion. If an operation is uncertain, use its existing receipt and recovery flow before trying another payment. Completed blockchain payments cannot be reversed by Keryx; signing out or stopping a budget does not refund funds or cancel already exposed payment authorizations. Contact support about an unresolved purchase or delivery problem so its original evidence can be reviewed.
legal.terms.pricesAndDelivery.uncertainP.text: 付款记录区分已结算、待处理、失败及模拟操作。待处理不证明付款完成。操作不确定时，尝试新付款前先使用原收据及恢复流程。Keryx 无法撤销已完成区块链付款；退出或停止预算不会退款或取消已暴露的付款授权。未解决购买或交付问题请联系支持，以审核原始证据。

legal.terms.questionsAndContent.publicat.source: Public research questions, answers, citations and payment activity can be published. Use the separately labeled private research mode where available for information you intend to keep out of the public archive, and review its processing and recovery disclosures before purchase.
legal.terms.questionsAndContent.publicat.text: 公开研究问题、答案、引用及付款活动可能发布。希望不进入公开档案的信息，请在可用时使用单独标注的私密研究模式，并在购买前审阅处理及恢复披露。

legal.terms.questionsAndContent.rightsAn.source: Submit or sell only material you have permission to provide. Listing a source authorizes Keryx to display its listing information and process and deliver the submitted content as needed for the access and citation workflow. It does not transfer ownership of your work. A listing does not guarantee purchases or rewards; reward eligibility depends on the content actually cited and the applicable payment evidence.

legal.terms.questionsAndContent.prohibit.source: Do not impersonate another person, misrepresent content ownership, manipulate payment evidence, distribute malicious content, or bypass access and spending controls. Respect the rights and access terms of the sources you use.

legal.terms.privacyAndAvailability.chang.source: Features can change or become unavailable during maintenance, provider outages or safety restrictions.
